name: bt_sal_le_stop_advertising

ownership.argument: Advertising stop. The name comes from the calling context (the beacon timer) plus the command wrapper shape, not from a function-name string, so it is the weakest of the three GAP entries recorded this pass.

provenance.source: Sends adapter command 0x44 through 0xC3AC47C with a 60-byte reply buffer; the beacon timer callback reaches it with the stored advertising handle and logs 'stop_advertising adv_handle:%p' around the call. 18 call sites.
